name: Takehara Akino
source:
Likes: Dicks (because they're cute), mushrooms (because they resemble dicks)
Dislikes: Whenever [url=/c33358]Ruriha[/url] lectures her

[url=/c35512]Seiji's[/url] classmate and the president of the Art Club (and the second out of the two members) who is airheaded and clumsy. After witnessing Seiji's dick the first time, she becomes completely attached to him and intrigued about it, even to the point of wanting to draw only pictures about dicks. Due to this, she is often lectured by her roommate, Ruriha, for so openly talking about dicks.
